title: Stranahan's Distillery Tour and Tasting Experience
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
all tour guests must be 21+. A valid ID will be required during check-in
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step inside Colorado’s first legal whiskey distillery since Prohibition and discover how Stranahan’s American single malt whiskey comes to life. Located in Denver, this immersive tour follows the handcrafted journey — from distillation to barrel aging to bottling. Along the way, enjoy exclusive tastings of award-winning whiskeys and receive $10 off a select bottle of your choice.

Tours are offered daily and include:

-Guided distillery walkthrough led by a Stranahan’s whiskey expert
-The story of Stranahan’s founding and its place in American whiskey history
-Tastings of four award-winning Stranahan's American single malt whiskeys

Perfect for curious newcomers and devoted whiskey fans alike.
